item.text: [{"task_id":"a2fd1cf0","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    start_color = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    end_color = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    path_color = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    horizontal_axis = int(round(params['axes'][0]))","    vertical_axis = int(round(params['axes'][1]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if horizontal_axis not in (0, 1) or vertical_axis not in (0, 1) or horizontal_axis == vertical_axis:","        return out","    starts = np.argwhere(grid == start_color)","    ends = np.argwhere(grid == end_color)","    if len(starts) != 1 or len(ends) != 1:","        return out","    start = starts[0]","    end = ends[0]","    horizontal_fixed = start[horizontal_axis]","    vertical_fixed = end[vertical_axis]","    horizontal_low = min(start[vertical_axis], end[vertical_axis])","    horizontal_high = max(start[vertical_axis], end[vertical_axis])","    vertical_low = min(start[horizontal_axis], end[horizontal_axis])","    vertical_high = max(start[horizontal_axis], end[horizontal_axis])","    for point in np.argwhere(grid == background):","        horizontal = point[horizontal_axis] == horizontal_fixed and horizontal_low <= point[vertical_axis] <= horizontal_high","        vertical = point[vertical_axis] == vertical_fixed and vertical_low <= point[horizontal_axis] <= vertical_high","        if horizontal or vertical:","            out[point[0], point[1]] = path_color","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"axes":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,2,3,8],"axes":[0,1]},"rationale":"Connect red to green with an azure L-shaped path: travel horizontally along the red point's row, then vertically along the green point's column. Preserve both endpoints. Colors and route orientation are encoded in six tensor entries."}]
